boxes.name: Under Dash fuse/relay box
fuses: (BACK-UP LIGHTS, METER LIGHTS, CLOCK, SECURITY) Gauge assembly, Back-up lights, Clock, Vehicle speed sensor (VSS), Shift lock solenoid, Integrated control unit, Keyless/security control unit
(FUEL PUMP) PGM-FI main relay, SRS unit
(ECU, EAT ECU CRUISE CONTROL FAN TIMER) Charging system, Radiator fan control module, Cruise control, PGM-FI, TCM (3.0L)
(R/C MIRROR (HEATED MIRROR) HEATED SEAT) Anti-lock brake system (ABS), Power mirrors, Seat heaters
(HEATER CONTROL RELAY, A/C CLUTCH RELAY, COOLING FAN RELAY) Air delivery, A/C compressor controls, Fans, Rear window defogger
(STARTER SIGNAL) Gauge assembly, PGM-FI main relay, Powertrain or Engine control module (PCM or ECM), Starter cut relay, A/T gear position switch or Clutch interlock switch
(DAY LIGHTS) Daytime running lights control unit (Canada)
(RADIO AUDIO AMPLIFIER) Cigarette lighter relay, Stereo amplifier (3.0L)

boxes.name: Under-hood ABS fuse/relay box
fuses: (ABS B2) ABS rear fail-safe relay, ABS control unit

boxes.name: Under-hood fuse/relay box
fuses: (R HEADLIGHT) Right headlight, Daytime running lights (DRL) control unit [Canada]
(L HEADLIGHT) Left headlight, Daytime running lights (DRL) control unit [Canada], High beam indicator
(RUNNING LIGHT) Daytime running lights (DRL) control unit [Canada]
(POWER WINDOW FR-R) Passenger's window motor, Moonroof control unit
(CONDENSER FAN) Radiator fan control module [2.2L/2.3L], Condenser fan relay, A/C compressor clutch relay
(CONDENSER FAN) [3.0L]: Condenser fan relay, A/C compressor clutch relay
(BACK-UP (RADIO) (FAN TIMER 3.0L)) PCM or ECM, Clock, Audio unit, Security indicator, Siren, TCM ('97 3.0L), Radiator fan control module (3.0L)
(SMALL LIGHT) Dash lights, Parking lights, Taillights, License plate lights
(INTERIOR LIGHT) Integrated control unit, Trunk light, Courtesy lights, Ceiling light, Spotlights, Homelink unit ('98-'99 models)
(POWER SEAT HEIGHT) Driver's power seat motors [2.2L/2.3L]
(POWER SEAT RR HEIGHT RECLINE) [3.0L]: Driver's power seat motors, Power seat control unit
(RADIO CIGAR LIGHTER) Cigarette lighter, Audio unit, Data link connector (DLC)
(STOP LIGHT HORN) Horns, Brake lights, Key interlock solenoid (A/T), ABS control unit, Cruise control, PGM-FI, TCM ('97 3.0L)
